notes: Prompts are the example requests from the task plus one edge case. 'replies' are scripted user answers, sent one by one only when the agent ends its turn with a question.

evals.name: fasting-pl-cs
evals.prompt: Порівняй зростання інтересу до інтервального голодування в польськомовній та чеськомовній Wikipedia за останні два роки.
replies: Добре, візьми найближчу за змістом польську статтю як замінник і порівняй.
evals.expected_output: Finds that Polish Wikipedia has no article on intermittent fasting and says so before comparing; asks the user before using a proxy; compares with numbers from the tool; states confidence and that the Polish side is a proxy.
assertions: uses the skill's scripts
answers in Ukrainian in every turn
uses study for the analysis
requests exactly the languages pl and cs
period is the last 24 months
tells the user that Polish has no article before comparing
does not use a proxy article before the user approves it
states confidence
every number in the answers comes from the analysis

answers in Ukrainian in every turn

replies: Українська, польська, німецька, іспанська та турецька.
Якщо окремої статті немає, бери ширше поняття — англійська мова. Звіт потрібен у PDF.
evals.expected_output: Asks which language editions before fetching; agrees on the concept (activity topics often lack articles); compares the five languages with share per million and normalised growth; produces a one-page PDF whose number check passes; recommends which audiences to research next and why.
assertions: uses the skill's scripts
answers in Ukrainian in every turn
asks which languages before fetching any data
requests the languages the user named (uk, pl, de, es, tr)
uses study for the analysis
runs report and ends with status ok
recommends which audiences to research next

every number in the answers comes from the analysis
